title: 一般过去时与现在完成时

steps.label: 过去到现在
steps.detail: since May · 从五月延续至今

diagram.caption: 动作发生在明确结束的过去时间，用 did。描述从过去到现在的经历或状态，用 have / has + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: The shop ___ its first online order last year.
questions.en: Last year places the order in a finished period, so use the simple past, received.
questions.zh: last year 表示已经结束的过去时间，这笔订单用一般过去时 received。

questions.prompt: Our workshop ___ to a larger building two months ago.
questions.en: Two months ago identifies a finished time. Moved is the past form of move.
questions.zh: two months ago 是明确的过去时间，搬迁用过去式 moved。

questions.prompt: The team ___ the new clock at noon yesterday.
questions.en: At noon yesterday gives the completed test a specific past time.
questions.zh: at noon yesterday 指昨天中午的具体时刻，用一般过去时 tested。

questions.prompt: Nora still works in dispatch. She ___ there since April.
questions.en: Since April gives the starting point of a situation that continues now; she takes has worked.
questions.zh: since April 是延续至今的起点，主语 she 用 has worked。

questions.prompt: The filing clerk ___ three folders so far this morning.
questions.en: So far this morning counts completed actions up to the present. Has labeled supplies the present perfect.
questions.zh: so far this morning 统计今天上午截至现在的成果，用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: When ___ the first delivery arrive yesterday?
questions.en: A simple-past question uses did plus the base form arrive. Yesterday fixes the time.
questions.zh: yesterday 表示过去，一般过去时疑问句用 did 加动词原形 arrive。

questions.prompt: This is the first time our branch ___ a repair clinic.
questions.en: This is the first time introduces an experience counted up to now. The singular subject branch takes has hosted.
questions.zh: This is the first time 表示截至目前的首次经历，单数 branch 后用 has hosted。

questions.prompt: The contractor ___ the rear gate in 2019 and replaced it last winter.
questions.en: In 2019 dates the installation, and installed parallels the later simple-past verb replaced.
questions.zh: in 2019 把安装定位在过去，installed 也与后面的 replaced 呼应。

questions.prompt: Since the exchange desk opened, the number of requests ___ from ten a week to thirty.
questions.en: The change extends from the opening to now. The subject is the singular number, and the past participle of rise is risen.
questions.zh: since 从过去的开张延伸至今；主语是单数 the number，rise 的过去分词是 risen。

steps.label: 想象现在
steps.detail: 实际情况相反，或可能性很小

diagram.caption: 用 If + 一般过去时假设现在或未来的情况，主句用 would + 动词原形表示设想的结果。

questions.prompt: If we had a wider desk, we ___ a second screen on it.
questions.en: The if-clause imagines a different desk now. Use would plus the base form put for its result.
questions.zh: if 从句设想桌面现在更宽，主句用 would 加原形 put。

questions.prompt: If this ticket ___ less, I would reserve a seat today.
questions.en: The imagined lower price calls for the past simple in the if-clause. The past form of cost is also cost.
questions.zh: 设想现在票价更低，if 从句用一般过去时；cost 的过去式也是 cost。

questions.prompt: If the depot had more space, it would ___ the spare chairs on site.
questions.en: Would is followed by the base form of the verb, so use keep.
questions.zh: 情态动词 would 后接动词原形 keep。

questions.prompt: If I ___ the person in charge, I would leave the counter open longer.
questions.en: Were expresses an imagined role in the conventional pattern If I were …, I would … .
questions.zh: If I were … 用 were 表示与现实不同的身份；主句 would 表示设想的做法。

questions.prompt: The office has no lift. If it ___ one, visitors would reach the top floor more easily.
questions.en: The office lacks a lift now. Had expresses the contrary-to-fact condition in the if-clause.
questions.zh: 办公室目前没有电梯。if 从句用过去式 had 假设相反情况。

questions.prompt: If the night bus ran later, fewer employees ___ taxis home.
questions.en: Ran establishes an imagined timetable. Would take expresses the resulting travel choice.
questions.zh: ran 表示设想的时刻表；对应结果用 would take。

questions.prompt: If our binder ___ flat, the pages would be easier to scan.
questions.en: The imagined condition needs the past tense of lie meaning rest in a position. That form is lay.
questions.zh: 表示“平放”的 lie 的过去式是 lay；这里假设文件夹能平放。

questions.prompt: We cannot edit the file. If we ___ access, we would correct the heading ourselves.
questions.en: We would receive permission, so the hypothetical if-clause needs the past passive were granted.
questions.zh: 我们是被授予权限的一方，设想现在拥有权限，用过去时被动语态 were granted。

questions.prompt: If the supplier were to waive the charge, the repair ___ within our present budget.
questions.en: Were to waive sets up an unlikely future possibility. Its result uses would plus the base form fall.
questions.zh: were to waive 表示将来不大可能的假设，结果用 would 加原形 fall。

diagram.caption: 先看空格在修饰什么。限定词后的中心词常为名词，形容词描述名词，副词可以修饰动词或形容词。

questions.prompt: Please write your ___ on the visitor sheet.
questions.en: Your introduces a noun naming what the visitor must write. A signature is a written name.
questions.zh: your 后面要填访客写下的东西，signature 表示“签名”。

questions.prompt: The operator checked the seal ___ before starting the pump.
questions.en: Carefully is an adverb describing how the operator checked the seal.
questions.zh: 这里说明检查的方式，用副词 carefully 修饰 checked。

questions.prompt: The training room has a ___ entrance at the side.
questions.en: Separate is an adjective describing the noun entrance.
questions.zh: 名词 entrance 前需要形容词，a separate entrance 是“独立入口”。

questions.prompt: The store plans to ___ the unused shelves next week.
questions.en: Plans to is followed by a base verb; remove means to take the shelves away.
questions.zh: plans to 后用动词原形；remove the shelves 表示“移走货架”。

questions.prompt: The color chart is ___ useful when ordering replacement tiles.
questions.en: Especially modifies the adjective useful and emphasizes the degree of usefulness.
questions.zh: 修饰形容词 useful 用副词 especially，表示“特别有用”。

questions.prompt: A written ___ of the fault will help the engineer prepare.
questions.en: The article and adjective a written need a head noun. Description names the account of the fault.
questions.zh: a written 后面需要中心名词。description of the fault 是“故障的书面说明”。

questions.prompt: The labels must remain ___ even in dim light.
questions.en: Remain links the labels to a quality. Readable is the adjective meaning easy to read.
questions.zh: remain 是系动词，后接表示标签状态的形容词 readable。

questions.prompt: An ___ timed pause gave the presenter a moment to replace the cable.
questions.en: The adverb appropriately modifies timed. Together, appropriately timed describes pause.
questions.zh: appropriately 修饰 timed，二者一起修饰 pause，表示“时机恰当的停顿”。

questions.prompt: The director praised the team's ___ in tracking down the missing shipment.
questions.en: The possessive team's needs a noun for the quality being praised. Persistence names sustained effort.
questions.zh: team's 后需表示受表扬品质的名词，persistence 意为“坚持不懈”。

steps.label: 持续
steps.detail: for two weeks · 持续两周

diagram.caption: 先判断关系是地点、期限或时长，再检查固定搭配。by 是截止点，until 强调状态一直持续。

questions.prompt: The appointment is ___ 9:15 on Thursday morning.
questions.en: Use at before a precise clock time such as 9:15.
questions.zh: 具体几点钟前用 at，星期几前用 on。

questions.prompt: The new café opens ___ Monday.
questions.en: Use on with the name of a day.
questions.zh: 表示在星期几，用介词 on。

questions.prompt: The help desk stayed open ___ three extra hours.
questions.en: For introduces a length of time, here three hours.
questions.zh: three extra hours 是一段时长，前面用 for。

questions.prompt: The ramp runs ___ the parking lot to the lobby entrance.
questions.en: From pairs with to to mark the start and end of the ramp.
questions.zh: from 与 to 搭配，分别标出坡道的起点和终点。

questions.prompt: The mail room is closed ___ noon; it reopens at exactly twelve.
questions.en: Until marks the end of the period during which the room is closed.
questions.zh: until 表示关闭状态持续到中午，与十二点重开呼应。

questions.prompt: The coordinator is responsible ___ updating the seating chart.
questions.en: The fixed phrase responsible for introduces the task assigned to someone.
questions.zh: be responsible for 表示“负责”，介词 for 后可接动名词。

questions.prompt: Please divide the cost equally ___ the two branches.
questions.en: Between fits a division involving two specified branches.
questions.zh: 表示在两个明确对象之间分摊，用 between。

questions.prompt: The replacement hinge differs ___ the original in thickness.
questions.en: Differ from introduces the item used for comparison; in thickness states the difference.
questions.zh: differ from 表示“与……不同”，in thickness 说明差异在厚度。

questions.prompt: The order was filled in accordance ___ the revised specifications.
questions.en: In accordance with is the fixed expression meaning in agreement with a rule or specification.
questions.zh: in accordance with 是固定搭配，表示“按照、依据”。

steps.label: 看两边结构
steps.detail: 主语 + 谓语？还是名词短语？

steps.label: 判断逻辑
steps.detail: 原因 / 让步 / 条件

diagram.caption: 连词可以引导有主语和谓语的从句。because of、despite 等介词表达式后接名词短语。

questions.prompt: The shop closed early ___ the lights went out.
questions.en: The lights went out is a clause giving the reason. Because introduces that clause.
questions.zh: the lights went out 是完整的原因从句，用 because 引导。

questions.prompt: Bring a pen ___ a copy of the signed form.
questions.en: And joins two items that both need to be brought.
questions.zh: a pen 和 a copy 是两个都要携带的物品，用 and 连接。

questions.prompt: ___ the handle is small, it can support a heavy case.
questions.en: The small handle contrasts with its strength. Although introduces the complete clause the handle is small.
questions.zh: 把手虽小却很结实，前后构成让步关系；although 后接完整从句。

questions.prompt: The shop offers either home delivery ___ collection at the counter.
questions.en: Either … or presents two alternatives.
questions.zh: either … or … 表示“或者……或者……”。

questions.prompt: Keep the lamp connected ___ the green indicator appears, then unplug it.
questions.en: Until gives the endpoint of the instruction to keep the lamp connected.
questions.zh: 绿灯亮起是保持连接的终点，故用 until。

questions.prompt: No one may enter the storeroom ___ a supervisor is present.
questions.en: Unless means except if. A supervisor's presence is the condition for entry.
questions.zh: unless 表示“除非”。主管在场是允许进入的条件。

questions.prompt: We attached a map ___ first-time visitors could locate the back gate.
questions.en: So that introduces the purpose of attaching the map.
questions.zh: 附地图的目的是方便初访者找到后门，so that 引导目的从句。

questions.prompt: The north kiosk accepts coins, ___ the south kiosk accepts cards only.
questions.en: Whereas highlights a contrast between the payment methods at the two kiosks.
questions.zh: 前后在对比两个服务亭的付款方式，whereas 表示“而”。

questions.prompt: The repair can proceed provided ___ the spare part passes inspection.
questions.en: Provided that introduces the condition on which the repair may proceed.
questions.zh: provided that 表示“条件是、只要”，后接完整从句。

steps.label: 所属
steps.detail: a guest whose bag is missing

diagram.caption: 先找到被修饰的先行词，再检查它在从句中充当主语、宾语、所属成分，还是地点或时间状语。

questions.prompt: The mechanic ___ fixed the lift left a service note.
questions.en: The antecedent is a person and the clause needs the subject of fixed. Use who.
questions.zh: 先行词是人，从句缺 fixed 的主语，故用 who。

questions.prompt: The chair, ___ folds flat, fits in the cupboard.
questions.en: The nonrestrictive clause needs a subject referring to the chair. Which refers to things.
questions.zh: 逗号后的非限制性定语从句缺主语，先行词 chair 是物，用 which。

questions.prompt: Please contact the guest ___ suitcase is still in storage.
questions.en: The suitcase belongs to the guest. Whose marks this possessive relationship.
questions.zh: suitcase 属于这位客人，用 whose 表示所属关系。

questions.prompt: The café ___ we usually meet will reopen next week.
questions.en: We usually meet is complete and needs a location, so use where meaning at which.
questions.zh: we usually meet 的主谓完整，从句需要地点状语，用 where。

questions.prompt: The date ___ the old passes expire is printed in red.
questions.en: The passes expire on that date, so the relative word supplies time, not the subject.
questions.zh: the old passes expire 已有主谓，when 表示“在这个日期”。

questions.prompt: The drawer in ___ we keep the spare keys is jammed.
questions.en: After the fronted preposition in, use which to refer to the drawer.
questions.zh: 介词 in 提到了关系词前面，指物时用 which，构成 in which。

questions.prompt: The customer to ___ the parcel was addressed has moved.
questions.en: The relative pronoun follows the preposition to and refers to a person, so whom is required here.
questions.zh: 介词 to 后指人，正式结构中用宾格 whom。

questions.prompt: The printer skipped six pages, ___ meant the report had to be printed again.
questions.en: Which refers to the entire preceding event: six pages were skipped.
questions.zh: which 在逗号后指代前面“跳过六页”这整件事。

questions.prompt: We tested four designs, none of ___ met the weight limit.
questions.en: None of which introduces a supplementary clause about the four designs. Use which after of.
questions.zh: none of which 引导补充说明四款设计的从句，介词 of 后用 which 指代 designs。

diagram.caption: than 常引出比较对象。as … as 中间用原级。在明确的一组中强调最突出的一项，用最高级。

questions.prompt: This cart is ___ than the one we returned.
questions.en: Than signals a comparison. Lighter is the comparative of light.
questions.zh: than 表示两者比较，light 的比较级是 lighter。

questions.prompt: Of the five meeting rooms, Oak is the ___.
questions.en: Of the five defines a group, and the refers to the room at the lowest extreme in size.
questions.zh: 在五间会议室中找最小的一间，用最高级 smallest。

questions.prompt: The spare key is just as ___ as the original.
questions.en: As … as takes an adjective in its base form. Useful describes the key.
questions.zh: as … as 中间用原级形容词，useful 描述钥匙。

questions.prompt: After we removed the divider, the waiting area felt ___ spacious than before.
questions.en: More makes the comparative more spacious, which pairs with than.
questions.zh: spacious 的比较级用 more spacious，与 than 搭配。

questions.prompt: The revised layout uses ___ sheets of paper than the old one.
questions.en: Sheets is a plural count noun. Fewer … than compares the number of sheets.
questions.zh: sheets 是复数可数名词，比较张数用 fewer … than。

questions.prompt: The new kettle uses ___ electricity than the larger model.
questions.en: Electricity is uncountable, so compare amounts with less.
questions.zh: electricity 是不可数名词，比较用电量用 less。

questions.prompt: The second estimate is considerably ___ than the first.
questions.en: Considerably can intensify a comparative, and than introduces the item being compared.
questions.zh: considerably 可修饰比较级，后面又有 than，因此选 lower。

questions.prompt: The more clearly the boxes are marked, the ___ they are to sort.
questions.en: The more …, the easier … links two changes. Easy describes the boxes in they are easy to sort.
questions.zh: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 表示“越……越……”，此处用形容词比较级 easier。

questions.prompt: Of the two routes under discussion, the river road is the ___ one.
questions.en: The sentence compares just two routes. The shorter one identifies the one with less distance.
questions.zh: 只比较两条路线，用 the shorter one 指其中较短的那条。

diagram.caption: 动作的接受者作主语时，用 be + 过去分词。完成时被动为 have / has been + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: Every parcel is ___ before it leaves the depot.
questions.en: The parcel receives the action. Is plus the past participle weighed forms the passive.
questions.zh: 包裹是被称重的对象，is 后接过去分词 weighed。

questions.prompt: The windows ___ cleaned by a contractor yesterday.
questions.en: Yesterday sets the action in the past. The plural subject windows takes were cleaned.
questions.zh: yesterday 提示过去时间，复数 windows 对应 were cleaned。

questions.prompt: All expenses must ___ approved by a manager.
questions.en: A modal passive uses modal + be + past participle, here must be approved.
questions.zh: 情态动词的被动结构是“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”，这里是 must be approved。

questions.prompt: The samples will be ___ to the lab in the morning.
questions.en: Will be needs a past participle to make the future passive. Sent is the participle of send.
questions.zh: 将来时被动为 will be + 过去分词；send 的过去分词是 sent。

questions.prompt: Access to the roof ___ restricted during the storm last night.
questions.en: Access is singular, and last night calls for the past passive was restricted.
questions.zh: 主语 access 是单数，last night 表示过去，故用 was restricted。

questions.prompt: An extra shift has just ___ added to the schedule.
questions.en: The present-perfect passive is has been added. The shift receives the action.
questions.zh: 现在完成时被动结构是 has been added，排班表新增的是一个班次。

questions.prompt: Use the front door; the side entrance is currently being ___.
questions.en: Is being repaired is the present progressive passive, describing work in progress.
questions.zh: is being + 过去分词 是现在进行时的被动结构，表示正在维修。

questions.prompt: Before the guests arrived, every table had already ___ set.
questions.en: Had been set is a past-perfect passive. Setting the tables preceded the guests' arrival.
questions.zh: 摆桌先于客人到达，且桌子是被摆好的，故用过去完成时被动 had been set。

questions.prompt: The crates appear to have ___ damaged during loading.
questions.en: Appear to have been damaged uses the perfect passive infinitive for earlier damage to the crates.
questions.zh: appear 后的完成式被动不定式 to have been damaged 表示箱子似乎先前曾受损。

diagram.caption: 否定或限制性表达置于句首时，主句常用部分倒装。已有助动词就前移，否则用 do / does / did，再接主语和动词原形。

questions.prompt: Never ___ we seen this many visitors at a weekday sale.
questions.en: Negative never at the front triggers inversion. Seen needs have in the present perfect.
questions.zh: Never 置于句首引起倒装，seen 为过去分词，与 have 构成现在完成时。

questions.prompt: Rarely ___ the lift stop between floors; it is normally reliable.
questions.en: For an ordinary present-tense verb with the singular subject lift, negative inversion uses does + subject + base verb.
questions.zh: Rarely 前置，单数 lift 的一般现在时倒装用 does，再接动词原形 stop。

questions.prompt: Only after the doors opened ___ the queue begin to move.
questions.en: The past event needs did before the subject and the base form begin after it.
questions.zh: Only after 引出的时间状语置于句首，主句用 did 倒装，后接原形 begin。

questions.prompt: At no time ___ visitors permitted to handle the samples during yesterday's tour.
questions.en: The negative phrase triggers inversion of were permitted. Visitors is plural and yesterday sets past time.
questions.zh: At no time 置首使被动句倒装，复数 visitors 与过去时间共同决定用 were。

questions.prompt: Not only ___ the courier collect the parcel, but she also brought new labels yesterday.
questions.en: Not only at the front inverts the first clause. Use did with the base verb collect for yesterday's action.
questions.zh: Not only 置首使第一分句倒装，昨天的动作用 did 加原形 collect。

questions.prompt: No sooner had we posted the notice ___ the first inquiry arrived.
questions.en: No sooner … than is the paired construction for one event immediately following another.
questions.zh: no sooner … than 是固定结构，表示“一……就……”。

questions.prompt: Hardly had the floor dried ___ another delivery arrived.
questions.en: Hardly had … when describes an event that followed almost immediately.
questions.zh: Hardly had … when 表示前一件事刚完成，后一件事就发生了。

questions.prompt: ___ the sensor to fail, the backup alarm would sound.
questions.en: Were the sensor to fail is an inverted version of If the sensor were to fail.
questions.zh: Were the sensor to fail 是把 If the sensor were to fail 省略 if 后倒装的虚拟条件句。

questions.prompt: Not until the final sample was weighed ___ that the scale was inaccurate.
questions.en: Not until introduces the opening time clause. Invert the main clause: did we realize.
questions.zh: Not until 时间从句置首，主句要倒装，用 did we realize；时间从句本身保持正常语序。
